index.subtitle: Reference data for travel payments: ranks, zones, rates and bands

master.futureOnlyText: Only a set that has not started yet can be deleted. This can't be undone.
master.amountInvalid: Enter every amount as a number with at most two decimals, for example 150000 or 12.50
master.seeDate: See the set in effect on this date
master.todayOrLaterHint: A date from today on (the fuel price may start today)
master.personalInvalid: Personal is required for overseas zones and must be empty for domestic and border zones

rankMap.title: Rank map
rankMap.line: Which rank each HRM PostType belongs to
rankMap.hint: Each HRM PostType must belong to one rank P1 to P9 before travel rates can be found for its staff.
rankMap.unmapped: {n} PostType has no rank yet | {n} PostTypes have no rank yet

countries.title: Countries
countries.line: Countries, their names and travel zone

borderRoutes.title: Border routes
borderRoutes.line: Border crossings used for border trips

rates.title: Rates
rates.line: Daily, accommodation and personal rates per rank and zone, by start date
rates.none: No set in effect on this date

flatRates.title: Flat rates
flatRates.line: Same-day rate, fuel price and kilometres per litre

advanceBands.title: Advance bands
advanceBands.line: Advance amounts by number of days (domestic) or group size (group)
advanceBands.rowInvalid: Each band needs a first and a last number (or none for the last) and an amount

glAccounts.title: GL accounts
glAccounts.line: General ledger accounts used for posting (read only)

postingEntries.title: Posting entries
postingEntries.line: Accounts debited and credited for each payment component (read only)

list.title: Travel agreements
list.subtitle: Agreements and notices of official travel (forms 1–4)

edit.title: Edit agreement
edit.notDraft: Only a draft can be edited. Cancel it and file a new agreement instead.

detail.title: Travel agreement
detail.cancelText: The agreement keeps its REF and its Doc.no becomes free for the replacement. This cannot be undone.

formType.district: Form 2: between districts of a province

form.docNoHint: As on the paper: NNNN.BCEL.888010.YYYY, ທຄຕລ or / also work
form.oneCountry: One country per agreement: a trip to two countries is two agreements

member.name: Name
member.acting: Filling the post of (ວ່າການ)
member.actingHint: Search by the first letters of the position

list.title: Travel payments
list.subtitle: Payments of approved agreements: check, approve, export and post
list.readyTitle: {ref} is approved and has no payment yet
list.readyText: Calculate its payment to open the checking table.
list.noPayment: {ref} has no payment, and only an approved agreement can be calculated by Finance

bills.title: Bills for nights from day 8
bills.hint: Enter the amount on the bill for each night, or 0 if there is no bill.
bills.invalid: Enter every bill as a number with at most two decimals, or 0

detail.title: Travel payment
detail.recalculateText: The payment is calculated again from the current rates. Bills you saved are kept.
detail.exportText: The payment is marked exported and the file for CORE is made from its posting entries. This cannot be undone.
detail.markPostedText: Confirm that the file was uploaded and posted in CORE. Add the CORE reference if you have it.
detail.cancelledAfterExport: Cancelled after its upload file was made
detail.cancelledAfterExportText: The agreement was cancelled. No reversal file is made: settle it with the bank.

errors.agreements_doc_no_invalid: Doc.no reads NNNN.BCEL.BRANCH.YYYY (or ທຄຕລ, or with /)
errors.agreements_doc_no_year: The Doc.no year is the year of the document date
errors.agreements_doc_no_taken: Another agreement that is not cancelled has this Doc.no
errors.agreements_days_invalid: More days subtracted than the trip has
errors.agreements_meals_invalid: More meals than three a day
errors.agreements_same_day: A trip without an overnight stay is one day
errors.agreements_route_twice: Choose a route or type one, not both
errors.agreements_unknown_position: This HRM position does not exist
errors.agreements_one_leader: An agreement has one team leader
errors.agreements_holder_required: Mark the member who holds the advance
errors.agreements_rank_unmapped: This member's position has no rank yet: ask an administrator to map its PostType
errors.agreements_account_missing: No account in this currency in HRM
errors.agreements_signed_copy_required: Attach the signed agreement before submitting
errors.agreements_not_draft: Only a draft agreement can be changed
